title: Shifting Papers
description: Paperwork that changes its own reference numbers mid-review would raise eyebrows at any border crossing — so should a login form whose field ids reshuffle underneath your test. Turn on the Practice mode toolbar's "Dynamic ids" toggle and prove your login automation survives it.
successCondition: With Practice mode's "Dynamic ids" toggle switched on (the red floating button, bottom-right of any page), a test logs in successfully at /login using a locator strategy that does not hardcode the current id/data-testid suffix — e.g. by label text or a stable prefix match — and the same test still passes after toggling "Dynamic ids" off and back on (ids differ between runs, the locator still finds the right field).
hints: The toggle lives under "Locators" in the Practice mode drawer, bottom-right of every page.
Inspect the email/password fields before and after re-enabling the toggle: the visible id changes, but there's a stable attribute or label you can key off instead.
